title: 1941 FBI vetting of Silas Newton

tellings.quote: A document from July 1st, 1941 mentions, he appears to be a good American citizen, has no accent in his speech,

plain: In 1941 the FBI looked into Silas Newton, a man it kept files on alongside a partner named Leo GeBauer, and who later became central to the story of a craft said to have crashed at Aztec. Michels reads from the files himself, quoting a July 1, 1941 entry: "he appears to be a good American citizen, has no accent in his speech". He sets it beside the book It Came to Earth at Aztec and the work of the researchers Scott and Suzanne Ramsey, as a look at how the government saw Newton years before the crash story.
